create_ice_age.ponder.breeze_freezer.tex: Breeze Freezers can provide Heat to Items processed in a Basin
For this, the Breeze has to be fed with freezable items
With an Ice Cake, the Breeze can reach an even stronger level of freeze
The feeding process can be automated using Deployers or Mechanical Arms
create_ice_age.ponder.empty_blaze_burner: Right-click a Breeze with the empty burner to capture it
Alternatively, Breezes can be collected from their Spawners directly
You now have an ideal freeze source for various machines
